2608.08139.title: TokenPrint: A Calibrated Token-Space Fingerprint for Language-Model Provenance
2608.08139.paper_summary: Establishing the provenance of a language model---including its base checkpoint and possible overlap in training distributions---is a governance challenge that metadata alone cannot resolve. We introduce a training-free fingerprint based on the top-$k$ vocabulary projections of late hidden states elicited by 250 fixed knowledge probes, compared using Jaccard overlap over decoded token strings. We evaluate the method on 32 open-weight models from nine families (0.6B--32B) with documented relationships. (1)~A \emph{similarity ladder} broadly follows model relatedness: independently trained models on identical data score 0.48 raw (0.35 vocabulary-corrected), followed by shared-base fine-tunes (0.39/0.33), same-developer relatives (0.38/0.28), and models with no documented relationship (0.22/0.17). This identical-data signal persists across three organizations, two tokenizer families, and two architecture classes, and emerges within the first 1\% of training before measurable task competence, suggesting a contribution from shared training data beyond capability convergence. (2)~As a nearest-neighbor \emph{lineage-retrieval} method, the fingerprint ranks the exact documented base among the top two candidates for all five R1 distillations (mean rank 1.8, MRR 0.60), including a math-specialized base not identifiable from coarse metadata. (3)~A \emph{depth ablation} shows that lineage group discrimination strengthens toward the output distribution, with AUC increasing from 0.72 at quarter depth to 0.90 at the output; using only the top 5 output tokens retains AUC 0.87. (4)~The fingerprint remains stable under quantization, with Jaccard similarity of 0.92 under int8 and 0.82--0.85 under int4, compared with a maximum cross-model similarity of 0.81 in the calibration pool. We release the probes, code, and fingerprints.
2608.08139.paper_summary_zh: 建立語言模型的來源，包括其基礎檢查點和訓練分佈的可能重疊，是一個僅靠元數據無法解決的治理挑戰。<lb/>我們引入了一種基於由250個固定知識探針引發的晚期隱藏狀態的前$k$詞彙投影的無訓練指紋，並使用Jaccard重疊比較解碼的標記字符串。<lb/>我們在九個家族（0.6B--32B）中的32個開放權重模型上評估該方法，這些模型有文檔記錄的關係。<lb/>(1)~一個\emph{相似性梯度}大致遵循模型的相關性：在相同數據上獨立訓練的模型得分為0.48（原始分數），0.35（詞彙修正），接下來是共享基礎的微調（0.39/0.33），同開發者的親屬（0.38/0.28），以及沒有文檔關係的模型（0.22/0.17）。<lb/>這一相同數據信號在三個組織、兩個分詞器家族和兩個架構類別中持續存在，並在可測量的任務能力之前的前1\%訓練中出現，這表明共享訓練數據對能力收斂的貢獻。<lb/>(2)~作為最近鄰\emph{血統檢索}方法，該指紋在所有五個R1蒸餾中將確切的文檔基礎排在前兩名候選者中（平均排名1.8，MRR 0.60），包括一個無法從粗略元數據識別的數學專用基礎。<lb/>(3)~\emph{深度消融}顯示血統組的區分在輸出分佈中加強，AUC從四分之一深度的0.72增加到輸出的0.90；僅使用前5個輸出標記保留AUC 0.87。<lb/>(4)~該指紋在量化下保持穩定，int8下的Jaccard相似度為0.92，int4下為0.82--0.85，與校準池中的最大跨模型相似度0.81相比。我們發布了探針、代碼和指紋。
